info.title: API.SH: Flickr
info.description: The Flickr API from API.SH: public Flickr data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Flickr member albums and album photos
get.description:
A member's albums, 25 a page: id, URL, title, description, photo and video counts, views, cover photo and its sizes. With `album`, that album's photos instead (id, title, description, license, views, faves, comments, taken and uploaded dates, every image size), 25 a page, with the album's details and owner. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flickr-albums

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Path alias, NSID or profile URL of the member.

parameters.name: album
parameters.description: Numeric album id (from the album list). When set, returns that album's photos.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Flickr group and its photo pool
get.description:
A Flickr group: id, alias, name, description, rules, members, pool and topic counts, language, moderation and 18+ flags, privacy, icon and link, plus a page of its photo pool (optionally only photos with given tags). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flickr-group

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A group alias, NSID or flickr.com/groups/... link.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Only pool photos with these tags (comma-separated).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Results per page (1-500, default 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Flickr photo: title, description, license with its link, owner (name, alias, pro, join date, icon), views, faves, comments, notes, likes, taken and posted dates, original size, every image size, keywords, place with coordinates (when public), albums and groups. With `exif=true` adds `exif`: camera, lens, exposure, aperture, focal length, ISO, exposure bias, flash, white balance, exposure program, metering mode, software, original date and every Exif row the photo page shows (null when the owner hides it).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flickr-photo

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Photo id, a flickr.com photo URL or a flic.kr short link (`url` is accepted too).

parameters.name: exif
parameters.description: Also return the photo's camera settings (Exif).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Flickr photos matching text or tags, 25 a page: id, link, title, description, license, owner, faves, comments, likes and every image size with its URL and dimensions. Filter by license, media type, taken or upload dates, orientation, dominant colour, style, minimum size, content type (photos, screenshots, art), safe-search level, a place (lat/lon with radius), Flickr Commons and photos in galleries (the filters applied are echoed in `applied_filters`); sort by relevance, date or interestingness. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flickr-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (q or tags is required).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags to match.

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Comma-separated Flickr license ids: 0 All Rights Reserved, 1 CC BY-NC-SA 2.0, 2 CC BY-NC 2.0, 3 CC BY-NC-ND 2.0, 4 CC BY 2.0, 5 CC BY-SA 2.0, 6 CC BY-ND 2.0, 7 No known copyright restrictions, 8 US Government Work, 9 CC0, 10 Public Domain Mark, 11-16 the CC 4.0 licenses (BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: all (default), photos or videos.

parameters.name: min_taken_date
parameters.description: Taken on or after (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: max_taken_date
parameters.description: Taken on or before (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: min_upload_date
parameters.description: Uploaded on or after (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: max_upload_date
parameters.description: Uploaded on or before (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Comma-separated: landscape, portrait, square, panorama.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Dominant colour(s), comma-separated: red, dark_orange, orange, yellow, school_bus_yellow, green, lime, cyan, blue, violet, pink, pale_pink, white, gray, black.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Comma-separated: blackandwhite, depthoffield, minimalism, pattern.

parameters.name: min_width
parameters.description: Minimum width in pixels.

parameters.name: min_height
parameters.description: Minimum height in pixels.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: photos, screenshots, art, virtual.

parameters.name: safe_search
parameters.description: safe, moderate or restricted.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a place to search around (with `lon`).

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of a place to search around (with `lat`).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Radius around lat/lon in km (default 5, max 32).

parameters.name: is_commons
parameters.description: Only photos from The Commons (public-domain archives).

parameters.name: in_gallery
parameters.description: Only photos that appear in a gallery.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The public groups a member belongs to, as the profile's Groups tab shows them: group id, name, link, member and photo counts, whether the member is an admin, whether it is invitation-only, and its icon. The whole list comes in one answer; groups marked 18+ are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flickr-user-groups

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: A Flickr path alias, NSID (e.g. 24662369@N07) or profile link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
